column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each weather and structural record.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing Location(LocationRegistry), tying weather data to a specific location.
A REAL value for the external ambient temperature in Celsius.
A FLOAT indicating wind speed in meters per second.
A DECIMAL(5,1) specifying the wind direction in degrees (0–359.9).
A NUMERIC(7,2) showing atmospheric pressure in hectopascals (hPa).
A DECIMAL(8,3) measuring solar radiation in watts per square meter.
A SMALLINT for current snow depth in centimeters.
A DECIMAL(5,2) representing ice thickness in centimeters.
A REAL value indicating visibility in kilometers.
An enum (PrecipitationType_enum) specifying the type of precipitation (e.g., Blowing Snow, Ice, Snow).
A DECIMAL(7,3) measuring precipitation rate in millimeters per hour.
An INT indicating the snow load on structures in kg/m².
A REAL showing structural load as a percentage of maximum capacity.
An enum (StructuralIntegrityStatus_enum) describing the building/structure condition (e.g., Warning, Critical, Normal).
A FLOAT recording vibration level in mm/s².
A DECIMAL(7,2) specifying noise level in decibels (dB).
An INTEGER foreign key referencing OperationMaintenance(OpMaintRegistry), linking weather/structural data to operation/maintenance records if needed.
